text: feature: if idea has a parent but when showing on the first level of a phase it is committed to, add 20 chars from the parent idea title + / in the beginning of the idea title.
description:
This should help prvoide context for short idea titles like "add text" that only make sense with their parent. But this is still unclear, because how do we treat multiple parents


HUMAN GUIDANCE: 
in idea search, let's introduce navigation feature: 
h shows list of supported ideas, l shos list of supporting ideas. This is relevant, because sometimes we find an idea but then want to select one of it's children.
